text: Hello, boys and girls, I'm Helen, nice to see you.Today, we are going to have the module revision, period one, the season I like, are you ready for the class?Let's begin.First, let's review the songs, please listen and read.Good job.Look at this girl, who is she?This is Kathy.Yes, she is Kathy.What does she wear?She wears a green scarf.What does she like doing?She likes skating on the ice.Now, let's read together.Nice reading.Now, please take out your workbook and turn to page 84.Let's look, read and match.Look at the passage.It is spring.Which picture do you choose?Yes, it is C.How's the weather in spring?Good.It is warm and rainy.Spring comes in March, April and May.Let's read this part.Have a try.Then, what about summer?Yes, it is D.How's the weather in summer?It is hot and sunny.Summer comes in June, July and August.Can you read this part?Which picture is autumn?Yes, A.How's the weather in autumn?It is cool and windy.Autumn comes in September, October and November.How's the weather in winter?Winter is B.Do you know the weather in winter?Right.It is cold and windy.Winter comes in December, January and February.It is very cold and windy.Please read.Yes, weather is different in different seasons, and weather is also different in different months.Please look at your workbook and turn to page 89.Let's look, read and complete.Have you finished?Let's check the answers.How's the weather in January?In January, it's cloudy and windy.How's the weather in July?In July, it's sunny and rainy.How's the weather in August?In August, it's hot and dry.Are your answers right?Look at Cathy.She's reading an email.It's about weather.Who writes the email?Let's read and answer.Yes, Kitty writes the email, but the email is not complete.Let's look, read and write.Dear Cathy, how are you doing?It is spring now.It is warm and sunny today.The sky is blue.The clouds are white.I go to Rainbow Park with my parents.We plant trees and have a picnic in the park.We take some photos too.I see many beautiful flowers there.They are red, white and yellow.I can smell the flowers too.They are nice.There are butterflies and bees.I like butterflies.They are beautiful.I like spring.How about you?Best wishes, Kitty.Have you got the right answers?In the email, Kitty is talking about the season she likes.What season does Kitty like?How is the weather?What can she do?Let's read the passage again and answer these questions.From the email, what season does Kitty like?Yes, she likes spring.How is the weather in spring?Yes, it is warm and sunny.What can she do in spring?She can plant trees, have a picnic, take some photos, see some beautiful flowers, and smell the flowers.Wow, what a nice season!Now, let's listen and read.They are butterflies and bees.This is Kitty's favorite season, spring.Then, what about Cathy?What season does Cathy like?Please look at her notes.Let's be Cathy and talk about the season she likes.Listen to her.Dear Kitty, How are you doing?I like summer.Summer is hot and sunny.In summer, I always go to the beach with my family.I like to go to the beach with my family.I like swimming in the sea, and I can swim very fast.My brother likes making funny sandcastles.We like to eat ice creams.So cool!And I hope to see you soon.Best wishes, Cathy.Yes, this is Cathy's favorite season.Kitty and her friends are at different places.What are their favorite seasons?They are writing emails.Look, this is Danny and Alice's email.It's a video.Let's watch.Hi, Kitty.I like autumn in Xinjiang.It comes in September, October, and November.It is cool and dry.The leaves are yellow and brown.I like playing football in the playground.I can eat a lot of fruits.So sweet!Hello, Kitty.I like winter in Harbin.It comes in December, January, and February.It is cold and snowy.I can make a snowman.It's fun.It is warm at home.I can drink hot milk.It's so nice.Yes, Danny likes autumn.It's cool and dry.He can play football and eat a lot of fruits.Alice likes winter.It's cold and snowy.She can drink hot milk and make a snowman.Kitty likes spring.Cathy likes summer.Can you be one of them and talk about the season I like?I like autumn.So much for today, goodbye boys and girls, see you next time.
